propositions: Prompt cache writes occur on every plan-review gate call but are never read across different calls, wasting premium-rate billing tokens.
Cache breakpoints are positioned after pass-specific suffixes rather than at the shared plan-prefix boundary, preventing within-run reuse across multiple verification passes.
The marked prefix deliberately embeds the full plan text by design, making cross-ticket prefix identity impossible without losing within-run container/chunk fan-out reuse.
The diagnostic for cache ineffectiveness only flags write==0 AND read==0, missing the write-every-call/read-never shape that wastes premium tokens.
Relocating the cache breakpoint to the end of the byte-stable shared plan-prefix boundary enables within-run reads by subsequent verification passes and same-ticket re-reviews inside the TTL.
